items.summary: Reject new production work, requeues, spending, telemetry, dependencies, deployments, monetization expansion, and unsupported financial claims. Active delivery is full, measurement and failure backlogs remain material, and revenue attribution and matching-period costs are incomplete. Continue only existing measurement, repair-or-close, finance reconciliation, legal/security evidence, and owner-gap verification. Keep private and parked states unchanged.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix and private launch gates. The submitted proposal duplicates active work and creates no new queue entry. Record dated evidence or explicit unknowns; do not access credentials or private containers, alter permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct outreach.

Reject the requested engineer batch this cycle. Active delivery is full at 10/10 slots with 63 overflow items; 42 improvements await measurement and 17 requests failed. Existing candidates are blocked by active or measuring work, failed-work containment, missing execution ownership, launch-readiness evidence, or unavailable security evidence. Do not create new implementation requests or requeue unchanged work.

Reject unsupported financial, ROI, margin, payback, forecast, and causal-lift claims. Amazon evidence is limited to $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 and cannot be assigned to a site. Matching-period costs, budgets, commitments, and learning thresholds remain unknown.

Continue existing measurement, repair-or-close, attribution reconciliation, legal/security evidence, and owner-gap verification only. Do not add telemetry, dependencies, credentials, configuration changes, deployments, spending, monetization expansion, or external outreach.

Preserve parked/private status for complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net. They remain unqueued because execution-owner verification and launch-readiness evidence are missing. Require dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement, rollback, and explicit blocker evidence before reconsideration.
